automation_scripts_rules.description: One-to-one mapping rule for direct test step to script line conversion.
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps where a single manual step maps to a single automation script line (e.g., steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 7).
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step directly corresponds to one automation script line.
THEN: Implement the automation using the mapped script line and follow all intermediary steps for that mapping.
IMPLEMENTATION: For example, for '2.Navigate to printer details screen.', use 'self.hpx_printer_details.click_printer_device_card()' and follow: ['Click printer device card to open details'].

automation_scripts_rules.description: One-to-many mapping rule for splitting test steps into sub-steps for multiple automation actions.
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps where a single manual step corresponds to multiple automation script lines (e.g., step 6, step 3, implicit add printer step, etc.).
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step corresponds to multiple automation actions.
THEN: You MUST split the step into sub-steps (e.g., 6a, 6b, 6c, etc.), each mapping to one script line, and implement all sub-steps in sequence.

IMPLEMENTATION: Step Breakdown: Step 6 → 6a → 'self.hpx_shortcuts.click_cancel_shortcut_go_back_btn()', 6b → 'self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_cancel_this_shortcut_title()', 6c → 'self.hpx_shortcuts.click_cancel_shortcut_yes_cancel_btn()'. Intermediary steps: ['Click cancel/go back button on shortcut popup','Verify cancel confirmation popup title','Click yes/cancel button on confirmation popup']. Execution order must be enforced and no steps skipped.

automation_scripts_rules.description: Purpose-based/supporting step rule for implicit steps required for test execution or validation.
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Any test case of type 'Verify the screen, when user clicks on the cancel button of 'Email' destination shortcut.' where implicit/supporting steps are present in the correlation.
rule_definition: WHEN: Executing test cases of type 'Verify the screen, when user clicks on the cancel button of 'Email' destination shortcut.'

THEN: You MUST include all implicit/supporting steps (e.g., 'Add supported printer on root view.', 'Verify edit shortcuts screen title before cancel.', 'Verify cancel confirmation popup title.') even if not explicitly mentioned in the manual test steps, as they are required for test case purpose validation.

IMPLEMENTATION: For 'Add supported printer on root view.', use 'self.hpx_printer_details.click_add_device_btn(), self.printers.search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress), self.hpx_printer_details.click_printer_device_card()' with intermediary steps: ['Click add device button','Search printer by IP address','Click printer device card']. For 'Verify edit shortcuts screen title before cancel.', use 'self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_edit_shortcuts_screen_title()' with intermediary step: ['Verify edit shortcuts screen title before cancel']. For 'Verify cancel confirmation popup title.', use 'self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_cancel_this_shortcut_title()' with intermediary step: ['Verify cancel confirmation popup title']. These steps are mandatory for fulfilling the test case purpose and must not be omitted.
